name: PT Nitrasanata Dharma Tbk
summary: PT Nitrasanata Dharma operates as a provider of eye health services in Indonesia. The company provides ophthalmic services including cataract, lens and refractive surgery, glaucoma treatment, retina care, okuloplasty and orbital reconstruction, pediatric ophthalmology and strabismus management, contact lens services, infection and immunology care, neuro-ophthalmology, dry eye treatment, and ophthalmic trauma services. In addition, it offers solutions, such as eye check diagnostics, tele-ophthalmology consultations, and services through the thyroid eye center. PT Nitrasanata Dharma was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia.
